commonSetup: New isolated browser context/page for each image; no reuse of state from earlier captures.
Clear localStorage and sessionStorage before application boot; set skey-proto-state signed-in=true, launchpad=true, simulate-loading=false; signed-in=false for sign-in states.
Theme=system, density=default, content-layout=fluid, interface-scale=100, administrator role; remaining prototype controls use pinned source defaults.
Hide prototype kit using #kit-hide; wait for skeletons to finish and document.fonts.ready; allow two animation frames.
Pointer rests at (0,0), no hovered target, no open menu unless the capture explicitly requires it.
For mobile-rtl dispatch the existing #rtl change handler with checked=true; assert html lang=ar, dir=rtl and an Arabic page/pane label. English uses effective LTR; never set dir directly.
Scroll positions for every fresh page start at origin; explicit per-state nested scroll exceptions below. Do not change CSS, replace rendered text, seed computed totals or mask defects.
Before a new image write, fail if its destination already exists; never use snapshot updates on existing directories.

collaboration.setup: No saved skey-proto-collab; application loads tracked COLLAB_SEED exactly. No mutation except e1 mark-read in reading state, and an unsaved invalid evt-1 end in validation state.

setup: Activate first [data-list-open-record], then select #mode=create via its real change handler.

invoice.limitation: Subtotal is a fixed 200 and tax is fixed zero; line monetary outputs stay zero even after entering prices. Capture actual prototype behavior; do not fabricate computed values. Nonzero-tax/line-calculation coverage is not approved or provided.
